blocks.text: 18 Registered user relates to a user having access to the system, implemented in frame of the referenced contract, where the user was identified with unique identifier and password , e.g. employees using the developed system, freelancers working for an institution and using the system as uniquely identified person, extranet users, etc. Registered user is not someone using the system, e.g. someone browsing a website or guest in an online shop cannot be understood in the contract reference as a valid user fulfilling this requirement.
